name: FreeSWITCH
description: Software Defined Telecom Stack enabling digital transformation from proprietary telecom switches to versatile software. Runs on any commodity hardware from Raspberry Pi to multi-core servers.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Example Dockerfiles to build FreeSWITCH and dependencies from source: /docker/examples. Contains /docker directory with 36,069 commits.

eval_notes: Major telephony platform with Docker build examples. Good for VoIP configuration, SIP routing, and telecom application evals. Most popular open-source telecom switch with 4.7k stars and 36k commits. Full PBX, conference, IVR, and media capabilities. Massive module ecosystem makes it ideal for complex VoIP and telecom evaluation scenarios.
